name: Breaking The Ten Commandments
overview: God revealed the Ten Commandments as His authoritative words to guide His people, establishing a standard for holy living. Jesus emphasized the importance of obeying and teaching even the least of these commandments, promising a greater standing in the kingdom of heaven to those who do so. Genuine love for Christ is demonstrated through faithful obedience to His commandments, underscoring that breaking them is incompatible with true discipleship.
